title: Keep an explicit display culture in F# diagnostic messages
goal: Format dates and numbers with an explicit culture before interpolating them when diagnostic messages must retain a chosen region across F# 10 and F# 11.

selectionNotes: Format dates and numbers with an explicit culture before interpolating them when diagnostic messages must retain a chosen region across F# 10 and F# 11.

packageAssets: FSharp.Core lib/net10.0/FSharp.Core.dll selected for net11.0; see evidence for the exact verified package
prerequisites: Create an F# executable project targeting net11.0; set LangVersion to 11.0 and reference FSharp.Core 11.
For the canonical diagnostics project, add --reflectionfree to OtherFlags. Regional culture checks require globalization data.
Add `open System` and `open System.Globalization` before the definitions in both versions.

stabilityLimitations: Verified using .NET 11 RC2 artifacts only; GA reconciliation remains required.
constraints: Ordinary and .NET-formatted interpolation holes use the new lowering; printf-format holes such as %A{value} retain the printf path and must not be used to claim reflection-free behavior.
Explicit scalar formatting does not give arbitrary nested objects the requested culture. Format their members yourself or provide an appropriate formatter.
